sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced: Q2 subscription and services revenue guided to $565M-$645M, down from Q1's $584M (which itself was down 16% QoQ). The company also guided full-year 2026 adjusted expenses to $4.3B-$4.6B, with $50M-$60M of restructuring charges, indicating cost-cutting rather than growth. The revenue miss ($1.4B vs ~$1.56B expected) and GAAP net loss of $394M further support a negative outlook. Management's tone is defensive, focusing on cost discipline and market share in a declining market, not raising forward expectations.

summary.revenue: Total revenue $1.4B, down 21% quarter over quarter, below the roughly $1.56B expected.
summary.eps: GAAP net loss $394M and EPS of -$1.49 against a small positive consensus.
summary.guidance: Q2 subscription and services guided to $565M to $645M. Tech, development and G&A expenses guided down 4% to 9% quarter over quarter, with $50M to $60M of restructuring charges. Full-year 2026 adjusted expenses $4.3B to $4.6B.
key_risks: Total crypto market cap and trading volumes both fell more than 20% quarter over quarter.
Institutional transaction revenue dropped 27% as low volatility cut hedging demand at Deribit.
Long-term fee compression acknowledged as a risk, with diversification the stated answer.
key_opportunities: We reached an all-time high in Coinbase crypto trading volume market share in Q1.
This is our 13th consecutive quarter of positive adjusted EBITDA.

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management guided expenses down and acknowledged fee compression as a risk, while focusing on cost discipline and market share gains in a declining market, indicating a cautious rather than confident outlook.
